'''''Ceratozamia mexicana''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Zamiaceae]].

It is [[Endemism|endemic]] to [[Hidalgo (state)|Hidalgo]], [[Puebla]], [[Querétaro]], [[San Luis Potosí]], and [[Veracruz]] states in [[Mexico]]. Its natural [[habitat]]s are subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests and subtropical or tropical moist [[montane forest]]s. It is threatened by [[habitat loss]].
